title: 第19章 偷袭第20章 老夫罩的人你也敢动
content_zh:
佳期不可再，风雨沓如年。
之前在地球的时候，就想平平淡淡，安安稳稳的过完一生，学习也不用太用功，以后随便找个班上，只要有一些钱，就勉强把生活度过去就行了，只要自己活的舒服，一切都不想管了，可是天有不测风云，来到这里之后发现，这是以力量为尊的世界，地球上的那一套，在这里根本行不通，力量就是绝对的秩序，力量就是绝对的一切！
应无悔这几天一直在学习拳脚功夫，一有时间就会温习，像这种肌肉记忆，不去经常熟练它就很容易忘记。
晚上都会花五六个小时修炼异能，自从练了狱火行者教的拳脚功夫后，他惊奇的发现，拳脚的功夫竟然能帮助异能更流畅的灌入心景，这功夫不仅能强身健体，还能舒活经脉，狱火行者还真是藏着一手，让我自己去领悟，呵呵。
最近在外面，虽然也能找到幽火草，但是数量遂渐变少，自从上次运气那么好以后，现在一天能找到两三株都算不错的，可能这里的幽草已经被我采光了，还有就是一些普通的跌打损伤的草药，像这种有异能的灵药，很少很少。
据欲火行者说，这里比幽火草更加珍稀的，可能手指头都数得过来吧。
在这底下已经生活了一个多月，蛇肉已经要吃光了，看来新学的拳脚功夫正好派上用场，到时候去捕捉些野味，填补一下空虚的肚子，有许多地方，我也设置了陷阱，只要猎物一旦踩中陷阱，触发机关，就必可捕获猎物，除非是异能兽，不然基本上都可以捕捉。
应无悔不仅练功夫还修炼异能，并且每天有一段小休息时间，他还会去给安安讲故事，或者传授一些知识，如果以后离开了他，安安也可以自力更生，主要看到时候我出了这山洞之后，给他找的那些父母，他自己会不会接受吧。
经过大量幽火草的帮助，应无悔隐隐约约感觉触摸到了高阶的门槛，再过几日应该就可以冲击高阶了！
拳脚功夫光练是没用的，还要有实战，狱火行者会抽个十几二十分钟，与应无悔对打一会，当然应无悔每一次都被打趴，每一次都被打的鼻青脸肿的，不得不服草药来加快恢复。
“就是这下面啊，可恶的庶民，竟然已经如此猖狂，杀了我的狗，也不看主人是谁？”
焱言身后带着两名二级异能的异能师，他们披着斗篷，露出半张脸来，看年龄，四十到岁左五十岁左右。
焱言霸气的往前走，他觉得这次这个庶民是死定了，自己一定要好好折磨他，然后再送他去西天。
这地底世界灰暗无光，这个庶民就像黑暗中的老鼠一样，喜欢在这些稀薄匮乏的地带找点垃圾吃一吃，才能苟活下去。
今天，本大爷就猎杀一只小老鼠，来缓解旅途中的乏味。
我看到了，前方那个山洞，呵呵呵！
焱言三人，悄悄默默的行进着，他们看到还有未烧完的柴火，洞内肯定有人，打他个措手不及！
“哟呵，抓到了！
这是什么东西？”
焱炎看着眼前这个脏兮兮的小野人，还挺狂挺倔，不服气的小眼神，我很喜欢，“叔叔，这就送你去地狱！

哦，等一下，你这里还有人吗？这个庶民见过吗？”
他将一幅素描画，从袖口中拿出，手上还掐着被抬起来的安安。
安安使劲地想挣脱，可终究是那个人的力量太大，她没有办法，只有用牙齿去咬他，“嚯嚯！
呀”
焱言立马加大力度，安安被掐的翻白眼，小野人还想咬我，哼！
content_en:
The good times cannot come again, and the storms are as bad as every year.
When I was on Earth, I wanted to live my life in peace and stability without studying too hard. From now on, I just want to find a class and just have some money to get through life. As long as I live comfortably, I don't want to worry about anything. However, there are unforeseen circumstances. When I came here, I found that this is a world where power is respected. The things on Earth simply don't work here. Power is absolute order, and power is absolute everything!
Ying Wuhui has been learning boxing and kicking skills these days, and will review them whenever he has time. Muscle memory like this is easy to forget if you don't practice it regularly.
He spends five or six hours at night practicing the superpowers. After practicing the fist and kick skills taught by the Hellfire Walker, he was surprised to find that the fists and kicks can actually help the superpowers flow into his mind more smoothly. This skill can not only strengthen the body, but also relax the meridians. The Hellfire Walker really has a hidden skill, let me realize it myself, haha.
Recently, although you can also find ghost fire grass outside, the number has gradually become less and less. Since you were so lucky last time, it is good to find two or three plants a day. Maybe I have already harvested all the ghost grass here, and there are also some ordinary herbs for bruises. There are very few elixirs with special powers like this.
According to the Desire Walker, there are rarer things here than the Dark Fire Grass, and they can probably be counted on their fingers.
I have been living here for more than a month, and I have almost eaten all the snake meat. It seems that my newly learned boxing and kicking skills will come in handy. Then I will catch some game to fill my empty belly. There are many places where I have also set up traps. As long as the prey steps on the trap and triggers the mechanism, the prey will be captured. Unless it is a supernatural beast, it can basically be captured.
Ying Wuhui not only practices kung fu but also special powers, and during a short break every day, he will tell An An stories or impart some knowledge. If he leaves him in the future, An An can be self-reliant. The main thing is whether he will accept the parents I found for him after I left the cave.
After a lot of help from the Nether Fire Grass, Ying Wuhui vaguely felt that he had touched the threshold of high-level, and he should be able to reach high-level in a few days!
It is useless to just practice fists and kicks, there is also actual combat. The Hellfire Walker will take ten or twenty minutes to fight with Ying Wuhui. Of course, Ying Wuhui will be beaten to the ground every time, and his nose and face will be bruised and swollen every time. He has to take herbs to speed up his recovery.
"It's down here. The hateful common people are so rampant. They killed my dog without even looking at who the owner is?"
Yan Yan was followed by two second-level superpowers. They were wearing cloaks and half of their faces were exposed. Judging from their age, they were in their forties or fifties.
Yan Yan walked forward domineeringly. He felt that this commoner was dead this time, and he must torture him before sending him to the West.
This underground world is dark and gloomy, and this common man is like a mouse in the dark, he likes to find some garbage to eat in these thin and scarce areas, so that he can survive.
Today, I hunted a little mouse to relieve the boredom of the journey.
I saw the cave in front of me, hehehe!
The three of them, Yan Yan, walked quietly and silently. They saw that there was still unburned firewood, and there must be someone in the cave. They caught him off guard!
"Oh, I caught it!
What is this? "
Yan Yan looked at the dirty little savage in front of him, he was quite wild and stubborn, and he had an unconvinced look in his eyes. I liked it very much, "Uncle, I will send you to hell right now!"
Oh, wait a minute, are you still here? Have you ever seen this commoner? "
He took out a sketch from his cuffs and held the lifted An An in his hands.
An An tried hard to break free, but after all, the man's strength was too great and she had no choice., I can only bite him with my teeth, "Hoo ho!"
Yeah"
Yan Yan immediately increased the intensity. An An rolled her eyes after being pinched. The little savage wanted to bite me, huh!
